## Freeze notice — step 1 (ruled by the maintainer, director thread 2026-10-25 13:39Z / 14:06Z / 14:40Z)

**Ruling.** No 24-hour lead: the freeze starts as soon as the ui lane's last in-flight seat PR is on objectui `main` (objectui#13529 merged 13:55Z, objectui#13526 merged 14:56Z). 「冻结的时候 objectstack 可以派任务吗」 → yes: objectstack dispatch, branches, PRs and CI continue throughout; objectstack `main` pauses merges **only** for the Tier H landing sitting. The objectui Version PR #13479 is closed, not merged (「关」, 14:40Z): no 18.2.0 ships from objectui; the first joint release is sub-issue 6 (#25753's sibling).

**What is frozen, from this comment.**
- **objectui `main`:** frozen until the repository is archived (step 8). The only commit still allowed is the final `.objectstack-sha` bump (step 2, #25727, in flight now). Nothing else is enqueued; open PRs are ported to objectstack in step 7 (`git format-patch … | git am --directory=ui`). Dependabot's auto-enqueue is already off (objectui#13527).
- **objectstack `main`:** NOT frozen. Merges pause only during the sitting below, because the four PRs touch root `ci.yml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, the lockfile, `turbo.json`, `AGENTS.md` and `CODEOWNERS`.

**Sitting (maintainer, confirmed 14:06Z): 2026-10-26 09:00Z (北京 17:00), ~30 min.** In order: cutover PR (subtree + adaptation commit, Tier H by size) → 4a #25745 → PR B #25697 → 4b PR 2 #25712, then the required-checks change (step 6; the exact context names are posted here before the sitting). If the 18.2.0 Version PR #25640 is merged before then, its publish must have finished (publish job green, npm verified) before the first Tier H merge, because 4a replaces the release pipeline.

**Timeline to the sitting (seat):** pin bump → objectui frozen ~15:45Z · adaptation patch series (#25803) ~18:00Z · cutover branch = `git subtree add --prefix=ui <frozen objectui main>` + the series, first CI ~16:30Z, final ~19:30Z, green target 21:00Z, hard limit 07:00Z · 4a re-check + PR B / 4b PR 2 rebased onto `main` by 23:00Z · handover (PR number, context names, order) to the maintainer by 08:00Z.

Prep cards landed before this notice: 2c rounds 1–2(b) (#25727), E #25762, F #25763, G #25766, H objectui#13497, I #25790; J #25803 (adaptation series) in work.

## Step 2 done — objectui `main` is frozen at `9e1fe032866965c7cb0460cff2b6af09350236b7`

The final pin objectui#13545 (`.objectstack-sha` → objectstack `5e7cf63e71d92198a77cc88ed22f34afb1e86cb6`) merged through the queue at 15:40Z; #25727 is closed. From here objectui `main` takes no commit: the cutover PR's `git subtree add --prefix=ui` imports exactly that tip, and any later objectui branch is ported to `ui/` in step 7.

Next (step 3–4, seat): fresh cutover branch off objectstack `main` = subtree add of the frozen tip + the lockfile recipe (bill 28) → first CI run; the adaptation patch series (#25803, in work, ETA ~18:00Z) goes on top, with the K1 scoping of `check:published-files` (ruled 15:07Z) → final run, green target 21:00Z. PR B (#25697 item 6, retire the pin gates) is in a seat's hands in parallel, draft + green by 21:00Z.

**Sitting brought forward to NOW (Tesla, 2026-10-25 22:42Z: 「开始，接受绕过」).** Steps 3–5 of this procedure run tonight: cutover PR #25825 (head `ac3de5a207`, run 6 green on every required lane) is ready for the maintainer's admin merge; then 4a #25745, then PR B #25827 and 4b PR 2b #25834, then the required-check adds (`Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`). Merges into `main` are stopped by the maintainer until the four are in; no release tonight. 4b PR 2a #25833 is already on `main`. Progress is recorded on each PR; this card gets the closing summary after step 5.

## Sitting closing summary 2026-10-26T00:39Z — steps 1–6 done, 7–8 carded · epic PM `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`

The Tier H sitting ran the night of 2026-10-25/26 under ruling 30 = B (each PR merges once the seat's local gate sweep is clean and the four fast lanes are green; test shards are read afterwards on `main`). Every merge was the maintainer's click after a GOVERNED_APPROVER review.

| step | result |
|---|---|
| 1–3 | freeze notice posted; objectui `main` frozen at `9e1fe03286` (2026-10-25T15:40Z); verify branch run 11 read, every red on the bill |
| 4 | cutover PR #25825 merged 2026-10-25T22:51Z → `main` `fd40831416` (subtree + adaptation series J #25803) |
| 5 | 4a #25745 merged 2026-10-25T23:29Z (`2a61f08093`); PR B #25827 merged 2026-10-26T00:07Z (`90a34e2039`); 4b PR 2a #25833 (before the sitting) and 2b #25834 merged 2026-10-26T00:24Z (`e167956e3f`) |
| 6 | required checks: `Lint UI` + `Build & E2E UI` added by the maintainer 2026-10-26T00:25Z; nothing to drop (neither retired gate was in the set, PR B measured). `--verify-required-set` on `e167956e3f`: 7 live, 2 required-but-unpinned → repo half is #25853. `Type Check UI` joins after #25855 (bill 49); `Test UI` not added (ruling 30). npm token: decision A, no change. Vercel docs project: #25753. |
| 7–8 | carded as #25854 (6 bot PRs to close, 69 open issues to transfer or close, migration-notice README PR, 381 `claude/*` branches, then the maintainer's archive click) |

**`main` after the sitting (`e167956e3f`):** push `CI` run 40249186268 — **success** (every required lane green). `Lint & Type Check` push runs stay red on one lane, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, since `fd40831416` — green on every PR run of the same trees; tracked on #25851 (bill item 50). Known test reds that appear only in the hourly full battery: `Test UI` 8/16 and 9/16 read the deleted `ui/.github/workflows/*` (next #25712 PR); `Test UI` 3/16 and `Test Core` 5/8 are fixed by #25852 (ready, auto-merge armed).

**Done-when read-back:** `ui/` is on `main` with objectui's history ✓; 4a, PR B, 4b PR 2 merged ✓; no `.objectui-sha` / `.objectstack-sha` and none of 4a's pin scripts in the tree ✓ (`git ls-files | grep -c 'objectui-sha\|objectstack-sha\|bump-objectui'` = 0 at `e167956e3f`); required set names no retired gate ✓. Still owed by #25854: objectui PRs/cards/archive. Hand-off to sub-issue 6 (#25753): the first joint release is 18.2.0 (both scopes, 112 members, one Version PR from the root lane; ruling 27 = B, not cut tonight; #25831 moves the 65 travelled changesets first).

Bill: `/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/5-cutover-bill-notes.md` items 1–50; superseded cards closing: #25829 (Console Pin Gate repair, gate deleted by PR B), #25810 (pin bump, pin deleted by 4a).

## Addendum 2026-10-26T00:48Z — correction to the closing summary: objectui's history is NOT on `main` · epic PM `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`

The #25854 seat measured it (00:46Z) and I confirmed on a fresh fetch: the cutover PR #25825 landed as a **squash** — `fd40831416` has one parent (`e2aaaf1c07`), and `compare/9e1fe03286...main` answers "No common ancestor". The PR's branch carried the `git subtree add` merge with objectui's history, but the maintainer's admin merge squashed it, so `main` holds objectui's **content** at `9e1fe03286` and none of its commits. The closing summary's "ui/ is on main with objectui's history ✓" is wrong; the done-when clause reads "content ✓, history ✗".

Consequences, as read now:

- The objectui repository is **archived, never deleted**: it is the only holder of the pre-cutover history (`git log` / `git blame` for anything older than `fd40831416`). #25854's README notice says so explicitly.
- Porting a branch still works (`format-patch` from objectui, `git am --directory=ui` into objectstack); the recipe in #25752 step 7 is unchanged.
- The rollback note ("`git subtree split --prefix=ui` restores a standalone repo") restores the content, not the history; the archived repository restores the history.
- **Open for the maintainer** (via the director thread): accept the content-only import as final, or stitch the history in with one later non-squash merge PR (`git merge --allow-unrelated-histories` of objectui `9e1fe03286` read into `ui/`, merged with "Create a merge commit" instead of squash). The epic PM recommends accepting: the archive preserves the history at zero cost, and a stitching merge adds ~9,000 commits to `main`'s log for `blame` convenience alone.

## Ruling 31 2026-10-26T01:01Z — content-only import accepted · epic PM `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`

Maintainer (director thread, 2026-10-26T01:01Z, verbatim): 「A」 — on the addendum above: the content-only import of objectui into `ui/` stands as final. objectui's commit history up to `9e1fe03286` lives in the **archived, read-only, never deleted** objectui repository; no history-stitching merge PR will be opened. #25854's README notice says where the history lives. The done-when clause of this card reads "content ✓, history by reference to the archive ✓".
